coreclr.role: reference: the matrix runtime (CoreCLR 9.0.22, RyuJIT, TieredCompilation=0, workstation GC); self-contained but not single-file (startup-only difference, cancels in the differential)

mono-jit.role: context: the same Mono build as the native column but with its default JIT instead of the interpreter

versions.wasmRuntime: Mono 9.0.22 interpreter (Microsoft.NETCore.App.Runtime.Mono.wasi-wasm 9.0.22) via the wasi-experimental workload
versions.wasmToolchain: wasi-sdk 24 (clang 18.1.2), target rewritten to wasm32-wasip1, WasmSingleFileBundle, no AOT
versions.flags: Release; wasm: -O2 via the workload defaults, 8 MiB stack, 50 MiB initial memory

transforms: languages/wasm/csharp/Directory.Build.targets: no-op redefinition of the workload's FailBuild target (the .NET 9 SDK aborts every wasi-wasm build)
languages/wasm/csharp/wasi-clang-p1.sh (-p:WasiClang): wasip2 component link rewritten to a wasm32-wasip1 core module so V8 can load it; sources and runtime pack untouched
asymmetries: the .NET 9 wasi-experimental workload is officially unsupported (SDK manifest error); the guard is bypassed; release/10.0 of dotnet/runtime keeps the same guard ('not supported in .NET 10') and pins wasi-sdk 25
wasm engine is Mono 9.0.22; no stable Mono linux-arm64 runtime pack exists for 9.0.x, so the native counterpart is Mono 9.0.0-preview.7 (same interpreter design, about 15 months of servicing older)
native Mono --interpreter may still JIT wrappers and trampolines; the wasm interpreter cannot
wasm assemblies are IL-trimmed (TrimMode partial/full by the workload); native Mono/CoreCLR apps are not trimmed
native Mono is built by Microsoft's linux toolchain, the wasm runtime by the workload's wasi-sdk 24 clang 18
Mono AOT (RunAOTCompilation) builds but crashes at startup on .NET 9 wasi; so no compiled-code wasm column and no matching native AOT exists
the CoreCLR reference column is not the matrix single-file image (same SDK/runtime 9.0.22)

GC: the native column runs with MONO_GC_PARAMS=major=marksweep (non-concurrent major collector); the wasm runtime is single-threaded, so its collector cannot run concurrently either, but the parameter itself is not passed to the wasm columns

class library: native preview.7 and wasm 9.0.22 ship different builds of the base class library (collections, Dictionary), not only a different engine; C# k-nucleotide fails on preview.7 for this reason, and other BCL-heavy cells may differ in managed library cost

na.k-nucleotide: the native control (Mono 9.0.0-preview.7 interpreter, the only Mono 9 runtime pack published for linux-arm64) fails the checksum gate with System.MissingMethodException: Dictionary<,>.GetAlternateLookup, an API added after preview.7; the wasm module (Mono 9.0.22) runs it correctly, but with no same-engine native cell there is no ratio
